title: 第21章 不可能，不可能是他！
novel_title: 唐逸孔诗岚全文完结版
content_zh: 狄苍很瞧不起唐敬，这要是他的儿孙这么成器，他做梦都得笑醒，结果唐敬这老东西竟然对唐逸弃之如敝屣！真不知道他那个阴险的大儿子有什么值得骄傲的。“唐敬那边我已经敲打过了，就看唐敬懂不懂朕的心思了，他的心思要是一股脑都在大儿子身上，那朕也帮不了他。”炎文帝轻叹口气，这个少年的确很让他欣赏。但欣赏归欣赏，他也不能插手臣子的家事。要是唐敬不能理会他的意思，依旧和唐逸对着干，那将来后悔的必定是这老东西。“这小子是个人才，陛下为何不直接培养？”老王爷有些疑惑地看向炎文帝。皇帝既然这么喜欢唐逸，直接给他个官做做，培养成心腹不就可以了？“还不是时候，火候还不到！”炎文帝摇头。随即，炎文帝脸上露出一抹狡黠，笑道：“再等等吧，现在他诗仙的身份，目前就只有咱们几个人知道。”“而孔家那妮子，为了阻止朕指婚，自己要搞个什么沈园诗会。”“朕倒是觉得，这倒是个好机会。”老王爷和狄苍愣了一下，就明白了炎文帝的意思。如今科考刚过，金榜题名的学子都在等朝廷给补缺的机会，要是直接让唐逸做官，肯定会让天下学子所不满。但如果唐逸能在沈园诗会力压所有人，名动天下，那就不会有问题了。“哎呀，最烦这些弯弯绕绕了，让人头晕，直接一点不好吗？”狄苍烦躁地挥了挥手，转身就往外走：“随你们怎么玩吧，老臣先不和你们聊了，哈哈，老夫先去状元街踩那群老家伙去！”现在，还有什么事情比踩那群文官更带劲？……状元街！此时，追了梁绍一路的各家仆从，也都相继回到了状元街汇报。户部尚书刘温，刑部侍郎赵轲等人听完下人的汇报，脸色阴沉得都能滴出水来了。“梁绍，平远伯的败家儿子，大字都不识几个，你们是怎么将他错认成那个能写《满江红》的斯文败类的？”刘温脸色铁青，敢给武将写诗词的文人，都是斯文败类。更丢人的是，动用权利找了两天，没有将这败类找出来就算了，今日还被人给耍了。“是有人说他是诗仙，而且还抛出了‘十年寒窗无人问，一举成名天下知’这样的名句，所以大家才对他深信不疑。”赵轲冷声说道，他堂堂刑部侍郎，审案查案的高手，竟然连这种小手段都没看穿，就那么被人给耍了。“这诗不是出自梁绍之手，应该是那个冤枉他的人……那个人应该就是我们要找的人。”唐敬沉声说道。只有那个写《满江红》的诗仙，才有这种水平。而他们，竟然让那家伙在眼皮地下溜了！深吸一口气压下心底的愤怒，唐敬问道：“查了吗？这么多人看着，总不能连当时和梁绍接触的人是谁都不知道吧？”话落，唐敬便看到所有人的目光都看向他，目光都极为怪异。“和我有关？”唐敬心头猛地一跳，总不能诗仙是他的画儿吧？赵轲冷笑一声，道：“我问了那个被梁绍收拾的老乞丐，他说梁绍在逃跑的时候，骂了一句唐逸，你大爷！”唐逸？那个懦弱的家伙？“不可能！不会是他的！”唐敬没有半点犹豫，几乎下意识地否定：“不会是他！我这儿子懦弱无能，在我大儿面前连头都抬不起来，他能有心气写这等诗？即便有心气，他也没那份能力！”“今日他来状元街，应该也是为了买诗而来。”“孔家即将要举行的沈园诗会你们应该已经知道了，唐逸正在为沈园诗会做准备。”“废话，我们自然知道不可能是唐逸，不然，你觉得大家还能心平气和和你坐在这里？”刘温冷哼，众人也在冷笑。诗仙真要是唐逸，现在早连你唐敬一起收拾了。“哈哈，告诉你们一个好消息，小诗仙又有新作了。”“这是小诗仙给老夫写的词，哈哈，这可是一首不输《满江红》的诗词！”这时，状元街上忽然传来了狄苍浑厚的声音。唐敬众人齐齐抬头看去，果然看到狄苍正龙行虎步走进了状元街。而听到他的话，众人脸色都阴沉下来。不可能吧？他们找了两天都没找到的小诗仙，狄苍不用找就找到了？而且，还亲自给狄苍赋诗一首？这斯文败类，真想和武将一条道走到黑吗？“诗仙又有新作了？真的假的？”“老将军，现在整条状元街，至少一百多个自称诗仙的人呢，你老别上当了啊！”“刚刚追一个假诗仙十余里，别不是又是假的吧？”“……”状元街无数人都向着狄苍围过来，都在议论纷纷，没有几个人相信狄苍的话。因为，他们刚刚上过当，追了一个纨绔子弟整整十条街，最后还给追丢了。“放心，老夫的手中的词绝对是小诗仙的真迹！”“行吧，今天老夫大发慈悲，让你们赏析下小诗仙送给我的词。”老将军虽然老了，但武艺高强，身体灵活，双脚在地上一踏，整个人便凌空跃起，轻松跳上了状元街的屋顶。随即，摊开手中的纸张，洪钟一般的声音传遍全场！“词名：《破阵子·为狄老将军壮词所寄之》！”“醉里挑灯看剑，梦回吹角连营。八百里分麾下炙，五十弦翻塞外声，沙场秋点兵。”“马作的卢飞快，弓如霹雳弦惊。了却君王天下事，赢得生前身后名，可怜白发生！”整条状元街原本嘈杂无比，然而随着老将军的声音响起，整条状元街便渐渐安静了下来。醉里挑灯看剑……开篇短短六个字，便将一个苦闷，忧思到独自喝闷酒的武将刻画得淋漓尽致。喝醉了，却不睡觉，反而挑灯看剑，孤寂，落寞的气息便扑面而来。后面视线直接拉到军营，将军营的生活，战场的壮阔都写到了极致，那是何等的气吞山河？然而将军收复山河的初心未改，却已经满头白发，何等悲凉？！如此笔力，除了诗仙，谁还有这本事？！因此老将军的已经念完了，但整条街依旧一片死寂，仿佛时间停止。茶楼中，唐敬，刘温等一群人，也都目瞪口呆，呼吸急促。这的确是一首好词，一首足以和《满江红》相媲美的词！可这两首词，都是站在武将的角度写的，所以两首词都气势恢宏，大气磅礴！可这两首词，都给了这些粗鄙武夫，简直暴殄天物啊！
content_en: Di Cang looked down on Tang Jing very much. If his children and grandchildren were so successful, he would wake up laughing in his dreams. As a result, Tang Jing, an old man, abandoned Tang Yi like a piece of shit!I really don’t know what his sinister eldest son has to be proud of."I've already dealt with Tang Jing. It depends on whether Tang Jing understands my thoughts. If his thoughts are all about his eldest son, then I can't help him." Emperor Yanwen sighed softly. He really admired this young man.But appreciation is appreciation, and he cannot interfere in the family affairs of his ministers.If Tang Jing couldn't understand what he meant and still went against Tang Yi, then it would be this old guy who would regret it in the future."This kid is a talented person, why doesn't Your Majesty train him directly?" The old prince looked at Emperor Yanwen with some doubts.Since the emperor liked Tang Yi so much, couldn't he just give him an official position and train him into a confidant?"It's not the time yet, the heat isn't there yet!" Emperor Yan Wen shook his head.Immediately, Emperor Yanwen showed a sly look on his face and said with a smile: "Wait a little longer, only a few of us know about his identity as the Poet Immortal." "And that girl of the Kong family, in order to prevent me from proposing a wedding, she wants to hold a Shenyuan Poetry Party." "I think this is a good opportunity." The old prince and Di Cang were stunned for a moment, and then they understood what Emperor Yanwen meant.Now that the scientific examination has just passed, the students who were named on the gold list are all waiting for the court to give them the opportunity to fill their vacancies. If Tang Yi is directly allowed to become an official, students all over the world will definitely be dissatisfied.But if Tang Yi can defeat everyone at the Shen Yuan Poetry Society and become famous all over the world, then there will be no problem."Oh, the most annoying thing about these twists and turns is that they make people dizzy. Wouldn't it be better to be direct?" Di Cang waved his hand impatiently, turned around and walked out: "You can have fun as you want. I won't talk to you anymore, haha. I will go to Zhuangyuan Street and step on those old guys first!" Now, what else is more exciting than stepping on those civil servants?...Zhuangyuan Street!At this time, the servants who followed Liang Shao all returned to Zhuangyuan Street to report.After listening to the report of the subordinates, Liu Wen, the Minister of Household Affairs, Zhao Ke, the Minister of Punishment, and others looked so gloomy that they could shed tears."Liang Shao, Ping Yuanbo's prodigal son, can't even read a few Chinese characters. How did you mistake him for the gentle scum who could write "Man Jiang Hong"?" Liu Wen's face was ashen. Literati who dared to write poems for military commanders were all gentle scum.What's even more embarrassing is that even after using my power to search for two days, I couldn't find this scum. Today, I was fooled."Some people say that he is a poet, and he also said famous sayings like 'No one asked him for ten years, and he became famous all over the world in one fell swoop.' That's why everyone has faith in him." Zhao Ke said coldly, he was a dignified minister of the Ministry of Justice and a master of investigating cases, but he didn't even see through such a small trick, and was fooled like that."This poem was not written by Liang Shao. It should be the person who wronged him... That person should be the person we are looking for." Tang Jing said in a deep voice.Only the poet who wrote "Man Jiang Hong" has this level of poetry.And they actually let that guy slip away before their eyes!Taking a deep breath to suppress the anger in his heart, Tang Jing asked: "Have you checked? With so many people watching, you can't even know who was in contact with Liang Shao at that time, right?" As soon as he finished speaking, Tang Jing saw everyone looking at him with extremely strange eyes."Is it related to me?" Tang Jing's heart skipped a beat. It couldn't be that Shixian was his painting, right?Zhao Ke sneered and said, "I asked the old beggar who was taken care of by Liang Shao. He said that when Liang Shao was escaping, he cursed Tang Yi, your uncle!" Tang Yi?That cowardly guy?"Impossible! It can't be his!" Tang Jing didn't hesitate at all, almost subconsciously denying: "It can't be him! My son is cowardly and incompetent. He can't even lift his head in front of my eldest son. How can he have the heart to write such a poem? Even if he has the heart, he doesn't have the ability!" "He should come to Zhuangyuan Street today."I'm here to buy poems.""You should already know about the Shen Yuan Poetry Meeting that the Kong family is about to hold. Tang Yi is preparing for the Shen Yuan Poetry Meeting.""Nonsense, of course we know it can't be Tang Yi. Otherwise, do you think everyone can sit here with you calmly?"Liu Wen sneered, and everyone sneered.If Shixian really was Tang Yi, he would have dealt with you and Tang Jing by now."Haha, let me tell you some good news. Xiao Shixian has a new work." "This is the poem Xiao Shixian wrote for me. Haha, this is a poem as good as "Man Jiang Hong"!" At this time, Di Cang's rich voice suddenly came from Zhuangyuan Street.Tang Jing and everyone looked up, and sure enough they saw Di Cang walking into Zhuangyuan Street.After hearing his words, everyone's expressions darkened.Impossible?They searched for Xiao Shixian for two days but couldn't find it. Did Di Cang find it without having to look for it?Moreover, he personally composed a poem for Di Cang?Does this polite scum really want to go all the way to the dark side with the military commander?"The Poet Immortal has another new work? Is it real or fake?" "Old General, there are at least a hundred people claiming to be Poet Immortal in the entire Zhuangyuan Street. Don't be fooled!" "I just chased a fake Poet Immortal for more than ten miles. Isn't it another fake?" "..." Countless people in Zhuangyuan Street gathered around Di Cang, talking about it. Few people believed Di Cang's words.Because they had just been fooled and chased a dandy for ten streets and lost him in the end."Don't worry, the words in my hand are definitely the original works of Xiao Shixian!" "Okay, today I will show mercy and let you appreciate the words Xiao Shixian gave me." Although the old general is old, he has strong martial arts skills and a flexible body. As soon as he stepped on the ground, he jumped into the air and easily jumped onto the roof of Zhuangyuan Street.Immediately, he spread out the paper in his hand, and a bell-like voice spread throughout the audience!"Title of the poem: "Broken Array: Written by General Di"!" "When I was drunk, I lit up the lamp and read the sword, and I dreamed of blowing the horns of the camp. Eight hundred miles apart, my subordinates were burning, fifty strings were heard outside the fortress, and the troops were ordered in the autumn of the battlefield."The bow is like a thunderbolt and the strings are shocked.The emperor's affairs in the world and his reputation in life and death happened in vain!"The whole Zhuangyuan Street was originally very noisy, but as the old general's voice sounded, the whole Zhuangyuan Street gradually became quiet.Reading the sword while drunk... The opening chapter, with just six words, vividly depicts a military commander who is depressed and worried to the point of drinking alone.I was drunk, but I didn't sleep. Instead, I burned the lamp and read the sword. The feeling of loneliness and loneliness came to my face.The view from the back is directly drawn to the military camp, the life in the general camp, the war
title_en: Chapter 21 Impossible, it can’t be him!
